name: Cheech & Chong - Singles - Cryo Infused Pre-Roll - Blue Jade (S)
description:
One joint, extra kick. The Cheech & Chong Blue Jade single is a cryo-infused pre-roll packed with quality flower and infused with distillate for a bolder, more potent smoke. No grinding, no rolling, no setup. Just light it and go.

Blue Jade brings a bright, layered profile: sweet blueberry and berry notes up front, cut with a crisp herbal edge and a smooth, subtly earthy finish. Blended with a sativa terpene profile for an uplifting, energizing feel — light, clear-headed, and made for daytime.

Why you'll love it:

Cryo-infused pre-roll — quality flower infused with distillate for extra potency
Cryo-infusion process — locks in flavor and delivers a smooth, even burn
Signature Blue Jade flavor — sweet blueberry with a crisp herbal, earthy finish
Sativa effects — uplifting and energizing, ideal for daytime
Cheech & Chong — a name that's been in the game since day one

Big flavor, dependable potency, and effortless convenience in every joint. Cheech & Chong Blue Jade is ready whenever you are.

For adult use only. Must be 21+. Keep out of reach of children and pets.
